verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline on one line and reads left to right, but the 'Find a Store' pill is jammed against the top and right canvas edges. The legal line stretches across the whole width right under the headline and CTA, and the can is a tiny afterthought under the logo. B wraps the headline into 'Garden-fresh / fizz', leaving an orphaned word. It also shrinks the legal text under the CTA to an illegible ~5px block, and the logo and can are cramped in a narrow stacked column. A is the less broken of the two.
